issue.description:
Gate: live-gate defect: omnimarket occ_ac_transcription.transcribe_ac_bindings markdown/rich-text comparison

Note on parent: [OMN-18238](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18238)'s own parent [OMN-18232](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18232) is at its unstarted-children cap (17, over cap of 10), so this is parented under [OMN-18143](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18143) per the orchestrator's fallback instruction.

Checked for an existing ticket first: [OMN-18236](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18236)/[OMN-18238](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18238) (Done — built the acceptance semantics and draft-proposal mechanism this bug lives inside), [OMN-18404](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18404) (Done — a different criterion-hash invalidation defect, annotation writes), [OMN-18406](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18406) (In Progress — a different deadlock between the binding gate and OCC append-only), [OMN-18362](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18362)/[OMN-18356](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18356)/[OMN-18048](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18048)/[OMN-18118](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18118)/[OMN-18577](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18577)/[OMN-18331](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18331)/[OMN-18332](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18332) are all related AC-binding-surface defects but none covers a markdown-escape round-trip mismatch specifically. No duplicate found.

Source: `docs/tracking/ROLLING_WORK_LEDGER.md` rows `:4013`/`:4015` (lane `closer-binds-ac-declare-0715`, read-only, root-caused mechanically).

`occ_ac_transcription.transcribe_ac_bindings` accepts a binding only when `unchanged` is true, comparing `criterion_units(rich_text_comparison_text(creation_revision.contentData))` against `criterion_units(markdown_comparison_text(live_description))`. Run live against [OMN-18620](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18620): `documentContentHistory` has exactly ONE entry, at `contentDataSnapshotAt` 2026-09-17T18:58:14.416Z, equal to `createdAt` — so nobody ever edited the description. AC1/AC2/AC3/AC4/AC6 hash EQUAL across the two renderings; AC5 alone differs, by exactly one character: the live markdown carries a backslash-escaped double hyphen before "falsifier" where the creation rich text carries a bare one. Linear escapes a leading double hyphen when it serializes a wrapped line to markdown, and the round trip is lossy — an UNEDITED criterion reads as moved and its acceptance is silently withheld.

Positive control on the other half: `contract_pin_hashes` over the live body returns all six pins byte-identical to the contract, AC5 included at `194d2a69245334241b1240258a6a3008f4869e66a37e9b3ed176d93a2da5f627`, so the criterion text is current and the [OMN-18330](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18330) stale-pin leg is not what is firing.

Two available unblocks were deliberately refused: writing `accepted_by` by hand forges the acceptance [OMN-18238](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18238) exists to require from a person, and adding a parallel hand-authored item declaring `binds_ac` for AC5 with no `ac_bindings` record would route around the draft-demotion mechanism to reach the same end. The fix belongs in the transcriber comparison, not in any contract; it will silently hold any ticket whose criterion wraps a line onto an escapable markdown token (at least `-`/`--`, `*`, `_`, `#` at line start).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: the transcriber normalises markdown escapes (at least `\-`, `\*`, `\_`, `\#` at line start) on BOTH renderings before hashing. -- falsifier: a criterion wrapping onto an escapable token still reads as moved after the fix.
- [ ] AC2: RED-first test using the [OMN-18620](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18620) AC5 body as fixture. -- falsifier: the test does not fail against the unmodified transcriber before the fix, or does not pass after.
- [ ] AC3: after the fix, the next scheduled evidence-autoclose sweep evaluates [OMN-18620](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18620) AC5 as bound without any human re-acceptance. -- falsifier: [OMN-18620](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18620) still holds on `gap_ac_unbound` for AC5 after the fix ships and the next scheduled sweep runs.

Gate condition for closure: [OMN-18620](https://linear.app/omninode/issue/OMN-18620) no longer holds on `gap_ac_unbound`.

— lane `overnight-bookkeeping-0620`, minted on the orchestrator's behalf
